LightningComponentBundle.description: Displays a map using Geolocation, Lat/Lon, or Text Address fields. Part of the Affordable Housing Accelerator (AHA).

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Text displayed in the header of the map card.

property.name: cardIcon
property.label: Card Icon
property.description: SLDS icon shown in the card header, e.g. utility:location or standard:address. To browse available icons visit lightningdesignsystem.com > Foundations > Icon Library.

property.name: zoomLevel
property.label: Zoom Level (1-20)
property.description: Controls how far in the map is zoomed. 1 = world view, 14 = street level, 20 = building level.

property.name: sourceMode
property.label: Location Data Source
property.description: How the component finds location data. 'address' uses text address fields — Google Maps geocodes them client-side, no Salesforce setup needed (recommended). 'separate' uses numeric Latitude/Longitude fields — requires Salesforce geocoding enabled in Setup > Data > Geocodes. 'compound' uses a custom admin-created Geolocation field.

property.name: streetField
property.label: Street Field API Name
property.description: API name of the field containing the street address, e.g. MailingStreet, BillingStreet, or a custom field like Property_Street__c.

property.name: cityField
property.label: City Field API Name
property.description: API name of the field containing the city or town, e.g. MailingCity or Property_City__c.

property.name: stateField
property.label: County / State Field API Name
property.description: API name of the field containing the county or state, e.g. MailingState or Property_County__c.

property.name: postalCodeField
property.label: Postcode Field API Name
property.description: API name of the field containing the postcode or zip code, e.g. MailingPostalCode or Property_Postcode__c.

property.name: countryField
property.label: Country Field API Name
property.description: API name of the field containing the country, e.g. MailingCountry or Property_Country__c.

property.name: latFieldName
property.label: Latitude Field API Name
property.description: (Source: separate) API name of the numeric Latitude field. Some standard objects populate this automatically, e.g. BillingLatitude on Account or MailingLatitude on Contact.

property.name: lonFieldName
property.label: Longitude Field API Name
property.description: (Source: separate) API name of the numeric Longitude field, e.g. BillingLongitude or MailingLongitude.

property.name: compoundFieldName
property.label: Geolocation Field API Name
property.description: (Source: compound) API name of a custom Geolocation field, e.g. Location__c or Site_Location__c. This is a special Salesforce field type that stores latitude and longitude together.
